topicDisplay: Topic 5 Social Activities Fitness And Health
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What does « les feux d'artifice » mean?
questions.explain: « Les feux d'artifice » means fireworks, set off e.g. on « le 14 juillet ».

questions.q: What does 'le réveillon' refer to?
options: A festive Christmas/New Year's Eve meal
questions.explain: 'Le réveillon' is the late-night feast on Christmas Eve or New Year's Eve. (The verb 'réveiller' means 'to wake', a related distractor.)

questions.q: How do you say « I gave up smoking »?
questions.explain: « Arrêter de fumer » means to give up / stop smoking.

questions.q: What does « être en forme » mean?
questions.explain: « Être en forme » means to be fit / feel on top form.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We celebrate Christmas with the family'?
questions.explain: 'Fêter' = 'to celebrate' and 'en famille' = 'with the family', so 'On fête Noël en famille' is correct.

questions.q: What does « une coutume » mean?
questions.explain: Faux ami: « une coutume » means a custom/tradition; a costume is « un costume » or « un déguisement ».

questions.q: What does « se balader » mean?
questions.explain: « Se balader » (or « faire une balade ») means to go for a walk/stroll.

questions.q: What does « un dessin animé » mean?
questions.explain: « Un dessin animé » means a cartoon (animated film); a comic strip is « une BD ».

questions.q: What is 'la fête nationale' in France, celebrated on 14 July?
questions.explain: 'La fête nationale' on 14 July is Bastille Day ('le quatorze juillet'), France's national day.

questions.q: What does 'le bien-être' mean?
questions.explain: 'Le bien-être' literally means 'being well' and translates as 'wellbeing'.

questions.q: What does « la matière grasse » mean?
questions.explain: « La matière grasse » means fat content in food; « gras » = fatty.

questions.q: What does 'J'ai l'habitude de lire le soir' mean?
options: I usually read in the evening
I used to read in the evening
I would like to read in the evening
I have to read in the evening
questions.explain: 'Avoir l'habitude de' means 'to be in the habit of / usually do', so this is 'I usually read in the evening'.

questions.q: What does « une nourriture saine » mean?
questions.explain: « Saine » means healthy/wholesome, so « une nourriture saine » = healthy food.

questions.q: What does 'mener une vie saine' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sain/saine' means 'healthy', so 'mener une vie saine' = 'to lead a healthy life'.

questions.q: What does « le sommeil » mean?
questions.explain: « Le sommeil » means sleep, e.g. « le manque de sommeil » = lack of sleep. A dream is « un rêve ».

questions.q: What does « le réveillon » mean?
questions.explain: « Le réveillon » is the festive meal on Christmas Eve or New Year's Eve.

questions.q: What does « grossir » mean?
questions.explain: « Grossir » means to put on weight; to lose weight is « maigrir ».

questions.q: What does « offrir un cadeau » mean?
questions.explain: « Offrir » here means to give (a gift), not just to offer.

questions.q: What does « équilibré » mean (food)?
questions.explain: « Un régime équilibré » = a balanced diet; « équilibré » means balanced.

questions.q: What does « se détendre » mean?
questions.explain: « Se détendre » means to relax/unwind, e.g. « je me détends en écoutant de la musique ».

questions.q: What does « tricoter » mean?
questions.explain: « Tricoter » means to knit; « le tricot » is knitting.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'You must avoid fatty foods'?
options: Il faut manger les aliments gras
Il faut éviter les aliments gras
On doit boire les aliments gras
questions.explain: 'Il faut' = 'one must' and 'éviter' = 'to avoid', so this means 'You must avoid fatty foods'.
